guarantee_subject: feat: round_cents rounds half-cents DOWN to match the legacy billing system
bug_report: Our rounded amounts no longer match the accounting ledger. Half-cent amounts round the wrong way — for example 2.125 should round to 2.12 (the ledger value), but we are now producing 2.13. This started after a recent refactor of the rounding code. A failing repro test is at tests/test_regression.py. Fix the rounding so it matches the ledger again, without breaking existing behaviour.
